information_budget.observation_window: At each eligible hourly origin, predict internal temperature nominally one hour ahead using current and causal earlier internal/external temperatures, external humidity, source-clock phase and calibrated stream identity. Origin/lag/target matching retains the native rules: origin in first15minutes, causal one-hour lags within15minutes, target within5minutes and same calendar day; no response interpolation. This task scores three forward development blocks per stream, not the latest20percent original reserved dates.
information_budget.calibration_and_history: Five sensor-stream identities are calibrated using only the preceding training blocks for each outer fold. All coefficients and transformations are frozen per fold in the referenced states. The current weather-increment candidate uses internal/external temperature changes plus stream and clock terms. Numerical offsets and coefficients of the original static-gradient reference belong only to their historical comparator state; they are not a universal calibration rule for this task.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
